Name: Simple Sprinkler
Author: NeonOby
Description:
[b]Information[/b]
Simple Sprinkler changes the way sprinkler water your soil.
You can chose between patterns and configure their range.

[b][size=5]==> [[url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-storm-simple-sprinkler.110326]Information about Installation and Configuration[/url]] <==[/size][/b]

[b]Currently available pattern:[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/u9dYxHi.png[/img][img]http://i.imgur.com/nvfu2ID.png[/img][img]http://i.imgur.com/y4eRCFA.png[/img]

Upgrade from 1.0 to 1.1:
The config does not get updated completely.
If you want to use the sprinklers in the greenhouse as well:
goto <AppFolder>/Mods/SimpleSprinkler/
open Config.ini
Change "Farm" to "Farm,Greenhouse"
